title: Out-of-band SQL injection (MySQL LOAD_FILE UNC)
remediation: Use parameterised queries so injected clauses cannot reach out-of-band sinks (xp_dirtree, LOAD_FILE over UNC, UTL_HTTP). Revoke the DB rights that enable network/file egress, and run the database on a least-privilege, egress-filtered account. The unique inbound callback proves injection.
